RELAY_KEY.description: The key your PC's bridge shares with this relay: base64url, 32 bytes. Make one with `node -e 'console.log(require("crypto").randomBytes(32).toString("base64url"))'` and keep it: you give the same value to `relay-setup --key`. See [the README](https://github.com/kazuph/ikesu/tree/main/apps/relay#readme).
